content.short: Connect to your Cardano wallet and experience your NFTs on the walls of your home.
content.description:
The NANO frame magically connects with your Cardano wallet and you control the entire experience using the NANO Smartphone App. But it’s not just about displaying static NFTs on the picture frame, it’s much more.

As a roadmap item, Nano Frames will enable content creators to easily turn their creations into NFTs and display them on the frame and potentially sell them and connect with their NFT holders. Nano Frames will offer an App Store to allow apps to build upon our platform for deep integration with the user’s creativity and the blockchain.
